# CliprAuto
> CliprAuto (Wiggle Entertainment AB, Kalmar, Sweden) rebuilds websites for small businesses and prepares sales packs for web and marketing agencies.

## Services
- [Clipr Website](https://cliprauto.com/website/): a new website from the business's own photos, words and colours. Free design concept first; $199 once (£199 in the UK) only if the customer says yes. No monthly fee.
- [Pitch Engine](https://cliprauto.com/agencies/): sales packs for agencies (business research, website findings, design concept, before-and-after image, outreach email). Free work sample, $99 pilot (three packs), Production Partner $249 a month (up to 15 packs), website production $349 per site, optional hosting $19 a month.
- [Sample sales pack](https://cliprauto.com/agencies/sample-pack/)
